image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a handmade baby bib lying flat on a white textured surface (likely a blanket). The bib features a diagonal color-block design: the left side is bright pink fabric with large white and light green polka dots, while the right side is white fabric with faint vertical pinstripes. The entire perimeter is trimmed with gathered, light blue ruffled lace. A yellow ribbon or tie is visible at the top neck area.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bib and distinguish it from similar garments like aprons or bandanas.
To verify the structural integrity of the complex ruffled lace trim and ensure the seams between the pink and white fabrics are physically coherent without melting or bleeding.
To assess the realism of the fabric folds, shadow consistency, and the detailed texture of the lace ruffles.

focus_areas: Integrity of the ruffled lace trim (checking for AI 'melt' or inconsistent repetition)
Seam alignment between the pink polka-dot fabric and white striped fabric
Physical plausibility of the fabric folds and shadows
Clarity and structure of the yellow neck tie
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the lace trim. AI generators often struggle with repetitive, fine-detail structures like ruffles, causing them to merge into the background or lose geometric definition. Verify if the lace maintains a consistent physical structure around the entire perimeter. Also, check the junction where the pink and white fabrics meet; ensure the seam looks like a stitched join rather than a digital blend.
